verdict.rationale: The product has some non-UI paths. The Codex CLI exposes a `/plugins` browser for installing plugins and a `codex plugin marketplace add` command that replaces hand-editing `config.toml`. Plugins and skills are file-based manifests (`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `SKILL.md`), so some management can be scripted. However, there is no evidence of a programmatic API matching the ChatGPT Plugins tab, and probes found no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404). Missing for 10: a documented REST/programmatic API for browsing, installing and managing plugins; parity coverage for ChatGPT web/mobile plugin and sign-in flows; an OpenAPI spec; independent confirmation of full UI-to-API parity.
